2609.08599.title: Graph-Based Personalized Memory for LLM Agents: Representation, Evolution, Retrieval, and Evaluation
2609.08599.paper_summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are evolving from single-session tools toward long-term personal assistants that must adapt to individual users across tasks, contexts, and interactions. This shift makes memory a core requirement for personalization, since user preferences, goals, constraints, relationships, and past experiences are accumulated gradually and often change over time. Graph-based personalized memory provides a structured way to model such user information through explicit relations, temporal context, and evidence links. Such representations can model not only what an agent remembers about a user but also how memories are connected, revised, and retrieved to support personalized decisions. However, existing work remains fragmented across personalized agents and generic graph memory frameworks, making it difficult to understand the design space as a whole. This survey develops a lifecycle-oriented view of graph-based personalized memory for LLM agents. We organize existing studies around memory representation, memory evolution, memory retrieval, and memory evaluation. We further compare key design choices, discuss current evaluation practices, and open challenges in building reliable long-term personalized agents. This survey aims to clarify how graph-based memory can support adaptive, controllable, and user-centric LLM agents.
2609.08599.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理正在從單一會話工具演變為長期個人助理，必須在任務、情境和互動中適應個別用戶。<lb/>這一轉變使得記憶成為個性化的核心需求，因為用戶的偏好、目標、限制、關係和過去的經驗是逐漸累積的，並且通常會隨著時間而改變。<lb/>基於圖形的個性化記憶提供了一種結構化的方式來建模這些用戶信息，通過明確的關係、時間上下文和證據鏈接。<lb/>這種表示方式不僅能夠建模代理對用戶的記憶，還能夠建模記憶之間的連接、修訂和檢索，以支持個性化決策。<lb/>然而，現有的研究在個性化代理和通用圖形記憶框架之間仍然是零散的，這使得很難理解整體的設計空間。<lb/>本調查針對LLM代理的基於圖形的個性化記憶發展了一種生命周期導向的觀點。<lb/>我們圍繞記憶表示、記憶演變、記憶檢索和記憶評估組織現有的研究。<lb/>我們進一步比較關鍵的設計選擇，討論當前的評估實踐以及在構建可靠的長期個性化代理方面的挑戰。<lb/>本調查旨在闡明基於圖形的記憶如何支持自適應、可控和以用戶為中心的LLM代理。
